# Sayyad Ali | personal portfolio

This site is the professional portfolio of Sayyad Ali, an early-career developer and university student in Pakistan.

## Current focus

- Frontend development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.js
- Responsive interfaces and component-based UI development
- WordPress site building with the Gutenberg editor and Elementor
- Learning WooCommerce and practical e-commerce development

## Experience and education

- Completed a remote Front-End Development Internship at DevSphere from 20 June 2026 to 20 August 2026.
- Completed a six-month remote Front-End Development Internship at DevelopersHub Corporation beginning in May 2026. The LinkedIn profile lists Responsive Web Design and CSS Flexbox among the skills used.
- Studying at Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (2025 to present). No degree title or graduation date is stated.

## Project practice

- Employee Management System: React learning project exploring dashboard, task-management, and application-state patterns.
- usePopcorn Movie App: React learning project for exploring movies, ratings, and a watched list.
- Notes App: browser-based JavaScript practice project with note creation, deletion, and Local Storage.
- SkinLuxe: WordPress skincare e-commerce practice project; in progress.

These are learning and practice projects. The portfolio does not claim that each is production-ready or publicly deployed. Repository and live-demo links are shown only when supplied.
